headline: Permit hearing for the Budget Inn Hotel/Motel, plus tattoo rules and opiate settlement discussion.
summary: A permit hearing for Budget Inn Hotel/Motel is scheduled. Tattoo rules, an opiate settlement discussion, and a 413Health quarterly report are also on the list.
items: Review of tattoo regulations, including temporary tattooing, tattoo course requirements, and guest tattoo artists
